english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unusual, distinctive, or set apart from the ordinary.
This is the all-purpose choice for something unusual or out of the ordinary, including 特別嘅情況.
Use this for something unusual or distinctive without necessarily saying that it is excellent.
Use this when something is unusual, distinctive, or not ordinary, rather than simply very good.
Use this when particular means special or distinguished, as in negative phrases meaning “nothing special.”
Use this when ‘different’ means unusual or distinctive, especially when the difference stands out as notable or special.

examples.traditional: 今日份蛋糕味道好特別。
